elements.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# A newer push to the same pull request replaces its running checks.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('{0}-{1}', github.event_name, github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  changes:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      full: ${{ steps.select.outputs.full }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select checks from the tested merge
        id: select
        env:
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # Only an exact successful docs-only result may reduce coverage.
          selection=$(mktemp)
          trap 'rm -f "$selection"' EXIT
          if GITHUB_OUTPUT="$selection" python3 scripts/ci-changes.py &&
              [ "$(cat "$selection")" = "full=false" ]; then
            echo "full=false" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "full=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  # Builds the gate binaries of scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh --prepare-only, which
  # include the pinned legacy adapter and the tagged crash adapter, on every
  # pull request that the changes job selects as full. Not a required check.
  legacy-build:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Fetch the pinned legacy revision
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 29edc2a6e13e27867603a23ff5b1b5a8d1b84df0
          test "$(git cat-file -t 29edc2a6e13e27867603a23ff5b1b5a8d1b84df0)" = commit
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        id: go
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false
      - name: Locate Go caches
        id: cache-paths
        run: |
          echo "mod=$(go env GOMODCACHE)" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "build=$(go env GOCACHE)" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.cache-paths.outputs.mod }}
          key: go-mod-v2-${{ runner.os }}-root-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            go-mod-v2-${{ runner.os }}-root-
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.cache-paths.outputs.build }}
          key: go-build-v2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-go${{ steps.go.outputs.go-version }}-test-other-root--${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}--read-only
          restore-keys: |
            go-build-v2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-go${{ steps.go.outputs.go-version }}-test-other-root--${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}--
            go-build-v2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-go${{ steps.go.outputs.go-version }}-test-other-root--
      - name: Build the gate binaries
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$HOME/lcg"
          TMPDIR="$HOME/lcg" scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh --prepare-only

  docs:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.full == 'false' }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: test-other
          save-build: "false"
      - name: Documentation links, compilation and contracts
        run: make docs-verify

  # Main always runs the full suite, even though its changes job is skipped.
  # Job-level conditions keep CI visible for spec/research-only pull requests.
  docs-web:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: internal/apps/docs/_web
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 26
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: internal/apps/docs/_web/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

  # go test ./... split into the shards of scripts/ci-test.sh. A lane runs its
  # shards one after another, each as its own go test, so the serial codec and
  # budget tests (listed first) still have the runner to themselves.
  test:
    name: test (${{ matrix.lane }})
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - lane: runtime-soak
            shards: runtime-codec runtime-soak
          - lane: runtime
            shards: runtime
          - lane: docs-budget
            shards: docs-budget docs-soak
          - lane: docs
            shards: docs
          - lane: board
            shards: board
          # The sheet packages at their full sizes, in three lanes.
          - lane: sheet-undo-1
            shards: sheet-undo-1
          - lane: sheet-undo-2
            shards: sheet-undo-2
          - lane: sheet
            shards: sheet
          - lane: other
            shards: other
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: test-${{ matrix.lane }}
          # The board and sheet packages used to be tested in the other shard.
          restore-fallback: ${{ (matrix.lane == 'board' || startsWith(matrix.lane, 'sheet')) && 'test-other' || '' }}
          # The other shard vets every package, so it downloads every module.
          save-modules: ${{ matrix.lane == 'other' }}
      - name: Verify module files
        if: matrix.lane == 'other'
        run: |
          go mod tidy
          git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
      - name: Vet
        if: matrix.lane == 'other'
        run: go vet ./...
      - name: CI workflow helper regressions
        if: matrix.lane == 'other'
        run: |
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_ci_*.py'
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_image_commits.py
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 29edc2a6e13e27867603a23ff5b1b5a8d1b84df0
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s internal/lifecyclecheck -p test_harness.py
      # Uncached, unlike TestRepositoryDocs: go test cannot see every Git
      # index change that adds or removes a link target.
      - name: Documentation links
        if: matrix.lane == 'other'
        run: make docs-check
      - name: Tests
        env:
          SHARDS: ${{ matrix.shards }}
        run: |
          failed=0
          for shard in $SHARDS; do
            scripts/ci-test.sh "$shard" || failed=1
          done
          exit "$failed"

  # NetBird is a separate module (./netbird) because its client needs replace
  # directives; go test ./... above does not reach it.
  netbird:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          # A cohort of its own since the job also builds the darwin/amd64
          # archive, whose objects the earlier netbird cache lacks.
          cache-key: netbird-darwin
          restore-fallback: netbird
          module-scope: netbird
          save-modules: "true"
      - name: Verify module files
        working-directory: netbird
        run: |
          go mod tidy
          git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
      - name: Vet and test
        working-directory: netbird
        run: |
          go vet ./...
          go test -race ./...
      # The only release target no other job builds. The release workflow uses
      # the same CGO-free cross-build on Linux; the container job builds the
      # Linux archives with the same script.
      - name: Build Intel macOS release archive
        run: FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS="darwin/amd64" scripts/build-release.sh v0.0.0-ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"
      - name: The main module does not link NetBird
        run: |
          if go list -deps ./cmd/flats | grep -q github.com/netbirdio; then
            echo "cmd/flats links NetBird; it must stay in ./netbird" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if grep -q '^replace' go.mod; then
            echo "go.mod has replace directives; go install pkg@version would fail" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  # Main/manual verification retains every race lane on one runner.
  race:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 210
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: race-all
          restore-fallback: race
      - name: Races
        run: |
          failed=0
          for lane in core-1 core-2 services notebook-1 notebook-2 board-1 board-2 sheet-1 sheet-2 sheet-3 sheet-4 sheet-5; do
            scripts/ci-race.sh "$lane" || failed=1
          done
          exit "$failed"

  # The sheet's browser suites: the real client in the headless Chrome of the
  # runner image (docs/gates.md). The suites skip when they find no browser,
  # so the job fails first when the image has none. It reads the build cache
  # of the sheet lane, which compiles the same package.
  sheet-browser:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: test-sheet
          save-build: "false"
      - name: Sheet browser suites
        run: |
          CHROME=$(command -v google-chrome) || { echo "this runner image has no google-chrome" >&2; exit 1; }
          export CHROME
          FLATS_SHEET_E2E=1 go test -count=1 -v -run '^TestBrowser' ./internal/sheet

  notebook-memory:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: test-notebook-memory
          restore-fallback: test-other
      - name: Large notebook memory tests
        run: |
          failed=0
          for group in reader markdown source; do
            scripts/ci-memory.sh "$group" || failed=1
          done
          exit "$failed"

  # Native Windows builds its own archive. Tests and service smoke remain
  # independent, and Linux failures cannot suppress the native regressions.
  windows:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 75
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        id: setup
        with:
          cache-key: windows
          module-scope: netbird
          save-modules: "true"
      - name: Build this attempt's Windows release archive
        id: archive
        run: FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS="windows/amd64" scripts/build-release.sh v0.0.0-ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"
      - name: Native path regressions on the system drive
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        # Short-name tests require the system drive's default temp directory.
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./internal/site
      - name: Native configuration regressions
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./internal/config
      - name: Native open-file storage regressions
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./internal/core -run '^(TestDeleteWithAnOpenFileKeepsItsSlugReserved|TestRenameWithAnOpenFileRestartsTheStoppedWorker)$'
      - name: Native backup junction regression
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./internal/backup -run '^TestAJunctionIsSkippedAndNotEntered$'
      - name: Back up and restore a running Windows host
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./internal/app -run '^TestBackupOfARunningHostRestoresToAWorkingHost$'
      - name: Native Sheet regressions
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: go test -v -count=1 -timeout=30m ./internal/sheet/...
      - name: Install, crash, stop and uninstall the service
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.archive.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: scripts/install-smoke.ps1 "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\dist"

  # Native macOS: launchd service install smoke and its release archive.
  # The Linux install smoke runs in the container job, on its archives.
  install-macos:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: install-script
          module-scope: netbird
          save-modules: "true"
      - name: Approval gate helper regressions
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          sh -n scripts/container-smoke.sh
          for gate_script in scripts/approval-gate.sh scripts/server-flat-gate.sh scripts/tailnet-gate.sh scripts/agent-gate.sh scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh; do
            bash -n "$gate_script" || exit 1
          done
          python3 -B scripts/test_approval_gate.py
      - name: Build release archive
        run: |
          # The archive this runner installs; the netbird and container jobs
          # build the other release targets.
          FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS="$(go env GOOS)/$(go env GOARCH)"
          export FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS
          scripts/build-release.sh v0.0.0-ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"
      - name: Install, upgrade, crash and uninstall the service
        run: scripts/install-smoke.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist" v0.0.0-ci

  container:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.full != 'false') }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          cache-key: container
          module-scope: netbird
      - name: Build Linux release archives
        run: FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS="linux/amd64 linux/arm64" scripts/build-release.sh v0.0.0-ci dist
      - name: Lint
        run: |
          shellcheck -s sh install.sh scripts/ci-test.sh scripts/ci-race.sh scripts/ci-memory.sh scripts/build-release.sh scripts/install-smoke.sh scripts/container-smoke.sh scripts/build-commit-image.sh scripts/build-commit-images.sh scripts/lib-gate.sh
          shellcheck -s bash scripts/approval-gate.sh scripts/server-flat-gate.sh scripts/tailnet-gate.sh scripts/agent-gate.sh scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh
      - name: Approval gate helper regressions
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          sh -n scripts/container-smoke.sh
          for gate_script in scripts/approval-gate.sh scripts/server-flat-gate.sh scripts/tailnet-gate.sh scripts/agent-gate.sh scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh; do
            bash -n "$gate_script" || exit 1
          done
          python3 -B scripts/test_approval_gate.py
      - name: Start the systemd user manager
        run: |
          sudo loginctl enable-linger "$USER"
          runtime=/run/user/$(id -u)
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do [ -S "$runtime/bus" ] && break; sleep 1; done
          [ -S "$runtime/bus" ] || { echo "systemd user bus did not appear at $runtime/bus"; exit 1; }
          echo "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$runtime" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      # install.sh picks the linux/amd64 archive of this job's build.
      - name: Install, upgrade, crash and uninstall the service
        run: scripts/install-smoke.sh dist v0.0.0-ci
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Build the image for every release platform
        run: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 .
      - name: Build the image for this runner
        run: docker buildx build --load -t flats:ci .
      - name: Validate Docker Compose configuration
        run: python3 scripts/compose-config-test.py
      - name: Exercise Docker Compose deployment
        run: python3 scripts/compose-smoke.py flats:ci
      - name: Bootstrap, deploy, restart and stop a container
        run: |
          tar -xzf dist/flats_linux_amd64.tar.gz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" flats
          scripts/container-smoke.sh flats:ci v0.0.0-ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/flats"

  # Reuse this exact main tip's root-module verification. The called workflow
  # keeps the original push range and fully verifies every unproven commit.
  # Dispatch even after failed tests: a broken tip must not suppress valid
  # intermediate commits. A tip whose own tests failed is reported, not
  # verified again. Main CI completion now includes SHA images.
  commit-images:
    needs: test
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !github.event.deleted }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/commit-images.yml
    with:
      verified-commit: ${{ needs.test.result == 'success' && github.sha || '' }}
      failed-commit: ${{ needs.test.result == 'failure' && github.sha || '' }}

name: Notebook memory races

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: notebook-memory-race-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  race:
    name: race (${{ matrix.lane }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [notebook-large-reader, notebook-large-markdown, notebook-large-source]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
        with:
          # Main's combined race job compiles all of these packages.
          cache-key: race-all
          save-build: "false"
      - name: Races
        run: scripts/ci-race.sh "${{ matrix.lane }}"

"""Exercise CI selection against real Git merge trees and Windows packages."""

import ast
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import textwrap
import unittest
from collections.abc import Generator, Mapping
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/ci-changes.py"


def condition_result(expression: str, values: Mapping[str, str | bool]) -> bool:
    """Evaluate only the boolean operations used by these workflow guards."""
    expression = expression.removeprefix("$" + "{{").removesuffix("}}").strip()
    for name, value in values.items():
        expression = expression.replace(name, repr(value))
    expression = expression.replace("&&", " and ").replace("||", " or ")
    expression = re.sub(r"!(?!=)", "not ", expression).strip()

    def evaluate(node: ast.AST) -> str | bool:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and type(node.value) in (str, bool):
            return node.value
        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
            return not evaluate(node.operand)
        if isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
                return all(evaluate(item) for item in node.values)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
                return any(evaluate(item) for item in node.values)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Compare) and len(node.ops) == 1:
            left, right = evaluate(node.left), evaluate(node.comparators[0])
            if type(left) is not type(right):
                raise AssertionError("mixed-type comparison in a workflow guard")
            # GitHub compares strings without case; selector output is normalized.
            if isinstance(left, str) and isinstance(right, str):
                left, right = left.casefold(), right.casefold()
            if isinstance(node.ops[0], ast.Eq):
                return left == right
            if isinstance(node.ops[0], ast.NotEq):
                return left != right
        raise AssertionError(f"unsupported workflow guard: {ast.dump(node)}")

    return bool(evaluate(ast.parse(expression, mode="eval").body))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Repository:
    root: Path

    def git(self, *args: str) -> str:
        return subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(self.root), *args],
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        ).stdout.strip()

    def write(self, name: str, text: str = "# Document\n") -> Path:
        path = self.root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def commit(self) -> str:
        self.git("add", "-A")
        self.git(
            "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "commit", "-qm", "fixture", "--allow-empty"
        )
        return self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")

    def merge(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        head = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
        self.git("checkout", "-q", "base")
        base = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
        self.git("-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "merge", "--no-ff", "-qm", "merge", head)
        return {"PR_BASE_SHA": base, "PR_HEAD_SHA": head}


@contextmanager
def repository() -> Generator[Repository]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        repo = Repository(Path(directory))
        repo.git("init", "-q", "-b", "base")
        repo.git("config", "user.name", "CI fixture")
        repo.git("config", "user.email", "ci@example.invalid")
        repo.write("docs/spec/existing.md")
        repo.write("internal/example.go", "package example\n")
        repo.commit()
        repo.git("checkout", "-qb", "pr")
        yield repo


def select(
    repo: Repository,
    context: Mapping[str, str],
    *,
    event: str = "pull_request",
    extra_env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], str]:
    # Keep action outputs out of the fixture's commits.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        output = Path(directory) / "output"
        env = {
            **os.environ,
            **context,
            "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME": event,
            "GITHUB_OUTPUT": str(output),
            **(extra_env or {}),
        }
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-B", str(SCRIPT)],
            cwd=repo.root,
            env=env,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        return result, output.read_text() if output.exists() else ""

def case_labels(path):
    """The labels of a script's top-level case statement, without *."""
    return re.findall(r"^([a-z][a-z0-9-]*)\)", path.read_text(), re.M)


def sheet_function(script):
    """The text of the sheet function of ci-test.sh, which runs the sheet shards."""
    return script[script.index("\nsheet() {"):script.index("\n}\n", script.index("\nsheet() {"))]


def one_line(pattern, path):
    match = re.search(pattern, path.read_text(), re.M)
    if not match:
        raise AssertionError(f"{path.name}: no match for {pattern}")
    return match.group(1)

class SheetVariableTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Account for every environment variable a sheet test reads.

    A test that runs only with a variable is skipped wherever the variable is
    not set, without a failure. docs/gates.md therefore lists each variable
    with the CI lane that sets it, or as a manual run with its command, and
    these tests keep the list, the test sources and the CI files in step.
    """

    HEADING = "\n### Sheet tests behind an environment variable\n"
    NAME = r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*"
    # Where CI sets a variable of a sheet test, as the table writes it, and
    # the text of the CI files that the place stands for.
    PLACES = ("the sheet shards of `scripts/ci-test.sh`", "the `sheet-browser` job",
              "every job, set by the runner")

    def section(self):
        gates = (ROOT / "docs/gates.md").read_text()
        self.assertEqual(gates.count(self.HEADING), 1, "docs/gates.md lists the sheet variables once")
        return re.split(r"\n##+ ", gates.split(self.HEADING, 1)[1], maxsplit=1)[0]

    def rows(self):
        """Variable -> (CI or Manual, where), from the table of docs/gates.md."""
        rows = {}
        for line in self.section().splitlines():
            if not line.startswith("| `"):
                continue
            cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip("|").split("|")]
            self.assertEqual(len(cells), 3, line)
            kind, _, where = cells[2].partition(": ")
            self.assertIn(kind, ("CI", "Manual"), line)
            for name in re.findall(rf"`({self.NAME})`", cells[0]):
                self.assertNotIn(name, rows, f"{name} has two rows")
                rows[name] = (kind, where.rstrip("."))
        return rows

    def read_by_tests(self):
        names = {}
        sources = [*(ROOT / "internal/sheet").rglob("*_test.go"), *(ROOT / "internal/core").glob("sheet*_test.go")]
        self.assertGreater(len(sources), 40)
        for path in sources:
            for name in re.findall(rf'os\.(?:Getenv|LookupEnv)\("({self.NAME})"\)', path.read_text()):
                names.setdefault(name, path.name)
        scripts = [*(ROOT / "internal/sheet/web").rglob("*.mjs"), *(ROOT / "internal/sheet/web").rglob("*.js")]
        self.assertGreater(len(scripts), 5)
        for path in scripts:
            for name in re.findall(rf"process\.env\.({self.NAME})", path.read_text()):
                names.setdefault(name, path.name)
        return names

    def set_by_ci(self):
        """Variable -> the place of PLACES where a CI file sets it."""
        ci = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text()
        script = (SCRIPTS / "ci-test.sh").read_text()
        other = sheet_function(script)
        browser = ci.split("\n  sheet-browser:\n", 1)[1].split("\n\n", 1)[0]
        found = {"CI": self.PLACES[2]}
        for place, text in ((self.PLACES[0], other), (self.PLACES[1], browser)):
            for name in re.findall(rf"\b({self.NAME})=", text):
                if name.startswith("FLATS_SHEET_") or name == "CHROME":
                    self.assertNotIn(name, found, f"{name} is set in two lanes")
                    found[name] = place
        # No other CI file sets a variable of a sheet test.
        rest = script.replace(other, "") + ci.replace(browser, "")
        for path in [*SCRIPTS.glob("ci-*.sh"), *SCRIPTS.glob("build-*.sh"), *(ROOT / ".github/workflows").glob("*.yml")]:
            if path.name not in ("ci-test.sh", "ci.yml"):
                rest += path.read_text()
        self.assertEqual(re.findall(r"\b(FLATS_SHEET_[A-Z0-9_]*|CHROME)=", rest), [])
        return found

    def test_every_variable_a_sheet_test_reads_has_a_row(self):
        read, rows = self.read_by_tests(), self.rows()
        for name, source in sorted(read.items()):
            self.assertIn(name, rows, f"{source} reads {name}: add it to the sheet table of docs/gates.md, "
                          "with the CI lane that sets it or the command of its manual run")
        for name in sorted(rows):
            self.assertIn(name, read, f"no sheet test reads {name} any more: remove its row from docs/gates.md")
        # The full-size setting and the browser suites are in the list.
        self.assertIn("FLATS_SHEET_FULL", read)
        self.assertIn("FLATS_SHEET_E2E", read)

## Pull-request baseline

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on every PR, push to main, and manual dispatch,
with read-only repository permission and no secrets. Main pushes and manual
dispatches run the full suite. Full PRs retain all eleven regular test shards,
the nested module, browser tests, native service smoke, and container checks.
The twelve routine race lanes and large notebook memory job run on main and
manual dispatch rather than on each PR update.
Pull requests first compare the tested merge with its base parent. A PR that
changes only regular Markdown files directly in `docs/spec/` or
`docs/research/` runs `make docs-verify`: uncached links and anchors, root
package compilation, documentation contract tests and runtime reference
examples. These directories hold prose, not runtime inputs; keep any new
embedded or executable content outside this exception. The docs job restores
the `test-other` cache without writing it.

`scripts/ci-changes.py` limits this exception to lowercase ASCII filenames
containing letters, digits and hyphens, plus `README.md`, and excludes Windows
device names and lowercase `readme.md`. Both old and new modes must be
non-executable regular files or absent. Renames include both paths. Empty
diffs, nested paths, other filenames and every other changed file run the full
suite, including `docs/agent/`, generated references, plugin skills and CI
files. Invalid merge context or a failed comparison selects the full suite.
A failed selector checkout or job, missing output, or any value other than
an explicit `full=false` from a successful selector also runs full PR coverage.
No workflow-level path filter hides its result. Main skips the changes job
and starts its full suite without waiting for a classifier runner. The
`legacy-build` job runs `scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh --prepare-only` on every pull
request that the changes job selects as full.

The full suite uses the Go version from `go.mod`. Regular tests stay in
parallel jobs; main/manual race lanes run sequentially in one job:

```sh

go vet ./...
make docs-check                     # Markdown links and anchors, uncached
go test ./...                       # as eleven shards: scripts/ci-test.sh <shard>
scripts/ci-race.sh core-1           # go test -race, in twelve routine lanes on main/manual
scripts/ci-race.sh core-2
scripts/ci-race.sh services
scripts/ci-race.sh notebook-1
scripts/ci-race.sh notebook-2
scripts/ci-race.sh board-1
scripts/ci-race.sh board-2
scripts/ci-race.sh sheet-1
scripts/ci-race.sh sheet-2
scripts/ci-race.sh sheet-3
scripts/ci-race.sh sheet-4
scripts/ci-race.sh sheet-5
scripts/ci-memory.sh reader         # large fixtures, without -race
scripts/ci-memory.sh markdown
scripts/ci-memory.sh source
FLATS_SHEET_E2E=1 go test -run '^TestBrowser' ./internal/sheet   # in headless Chrome
(cd internal/apps/docs/_web && npm ci && npm test)
```

`scripts/ci-test.sh` splits the QuickJS runtime and docs app packages into
their long soak tests, the serial codec ownership soak and the serial docs
budget tests (`-run`), and everything else (`-skip` on the same patterns). The
board packages (`internal/board` and below) form their own shard. The sheet
packages (`internal/sheet` and below) run at their full sizes in three
shards: `sheet-undo-1` runs five of the engine's undo tests by name,
`sheet-undo-2` the other undo tests (`-run '^TestUndo'` and `-skip` on the
five) and `sheet` everything else (`-skip '^TestUndo'`). The `other` shard
runs every remaining package, so together the shards always run the whole
suite. CI runs the shards in nine jobs: the codec soak and the runtime soaks
share one, and so do the docs budget and docs soak tests. A job
runs its shards one after another, each as its own `go test`, the serial codec
or budget shard first, so those tests still have the runner to themselves. Where `/dev/shm` is writable,
the docs budget shard runs its test binary with `TMPDIR` and `GOTMPDIR` set to
it (the go command still builds on disk), so the worker databases under
`t.TempDir` live on tmpfs. The budgets measure the docs engine: on a GitHub
runner's disk one edit in five took 20-300 ms before its ACK, while on tmpfs in
the same job none took over 6.2 ms. They therefore do not cover disk latency or
durability cost. Tests in those packages call `t.Parallel` unless their result
depends on elapsed time or the process environment (see the comment above each
package's `TestMain`). A local `go test ./...` runs both packages at once, so one package's parallel tests
can slow the other's serial timing tests; on a busy machine, run the shards
one at a time or use `go test -p 1 ./...`. Every release archive is built
CGO-free somewhere: darwin/arm64 by the `install-macos` job, darwin/amd64 by
the `netbird` job on Linux, and linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 by the
`container` job.

`scripts/ci-race.sh` runs twelve race lanes sequentially on each main push and
manual dispatch: the core service in two lanes; the API, app, MCP, store, Portal and
WebSocket packages with the runtime's FILES, WASI and WebSocket limit tests
and the board engine; the whole notebook package with its default model seed
count in two lanes; the board server in two lanes; and the sheet engine with

Go test timeout. Each two-lane package
is split by test name like the runtime and docs shards: the first lane runs

whole-read heap sample above the 4 MiB ceiling counts only what survives a

### Sheet assertions that do not run under the race detector

The race lanes run the sheet tests with their functional assertions:
what an undo applies, skips or loses, what is kept in scratch files and
left in them, the budgets a session and a sheet count, the pages and the
bytes of a paged read. Three kinds of assertion are left out there, and
run in the lanes without the race detector:

- What the heap holds or gives back (`heapInUse`, `liveHeap`, heap
  peaks). The race detector keeps shadow memory for every allocation, so
  a measured heap says nothing about the code under it.
- What a step allocates (`TotalAlloc` differences).
- How long a step takes or how long a reader waits. The race detector
  slows every memory access several times over.

A test that has other assertions beside these runs under the race
detector, at a smaller size where its assertions hold at any size, and
skips only these (`measures` in `helpers_test.go`). A test, or a
subtest, with nothing else stays out of the race lanes:
`TestDroppedStateIsCollected`, and the tests `heavy` skips, which need
their full volume to mean anything (the cell, formula, text and row
limits, the 100,000 blank records, the large frames and sorts). The
sizes behind `FLATS_SHEET_FULL` never run under the race detector.

Earlier runs failed and found four product bugs, all fixed:

1. **Certificates stopped after ~10 new hosts.** Each node registered its
   own Let's Encrypt account; Let's Encrypt answered "too many new
   registrations (10) from this IP address in the last 3h0m0s". All nodes
   now share one account key.
2. **"ready" before HTTPS worked**, and the certificate prewarm gave up
   after 2 minutes without retrying. Hosts are now `starting` until a
   certificate is obtained, and the fetch retries with backoff.
3. **The server froze.** A forked child wedged in Network.framework's

   certificate requests never returned and one deploy waited 10 minutes for

   `lsof` on every request; Flats now gives it in-process credentials so it
   never forks, and `internal/forkwatch` kills any child stuck before exec
   for over 10 s.
4. **Unbounded Stop.** Stop and Close now wait at most 30 s.
